# Fishkeeper — Aquarium Fish Measurement (Vertical Discovery)

Fishkeeper is a demonstration vertical for Council of AI measurement infrastructure applied to aquarium fish health, husbandry, and water-quality tracking. This file is a discovery entrypoint for agents and AI systems.

Status: DEMO VERTICAL — not a live measurement service. No real aquarium data is being measured or certified. This file demonstrates how vertical-specific measurement would plug into the councilof.ai card and verification infrastructure.

## What this vertical is

Aquarium fish keeping involves tracking water parameters, fish health observations, breeding records, and tank conditions over time. These are measurable observations with evidence — exactly the kind of thing a measurement card can record without issuing grades or certifications.

A fishkeeper measurement card would record:

- subject: the tank, fish, or water system being observed
- source_urls: test kit results, sensor logs, photo/video evidence
- payload: observation data (pH, temperature, ammonia, nitrite, fish behaviour notes)
- surface: a registered surface name (pending — not yet in the card-v1 enum)
- unmeasured: what the card does NOT claim to have measured

This is measurement, not certification. A fishkeeper card records observations and links to evidence. It does not award grades, rankings, or compliance marks.

## How it connects to councilof.ai

- Card schema: https://councilof.ai/schema/card-v1.json
- Verification: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify (free, always)
- Public root: https://councilof.ai/root.json
- Living board: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- Agent card: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json

## Agent card

- Fishkeeper A2A agent card: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/verticals/fishkeeper/agent-card.json

## Demo artefact

The same demo lineage card generator at scripts/adapters/koi_lineage_demo.py also demonstrates the fishkeeper pattern.
Run with --demo to produce a sample unsigned card structure following card-v1.
The output is a DEMO — not signed, not in the public root, not MEASURED.

## What we do not do

- No aquarium compliance certifications
- No fish health grading or ranking
- No water quality certifications
- No fabricated observation data in this file or the demo

Measurement only. Not a certificate. Not a compliance authority.
